nary_nodes.label: Screening as precaution
evidence: Health Minister Roger Kamba said screening was being carried out as a precautionary measure after a passenger with fever and diarrhoea, who had left the boat in Mongala Province, died in hospital.

nary_nodes.label: No positive tests yet
evidence: "For now, no-one has tested positive, and it is likely no one will be positive after 21 days of incubation has elapsed," Kamba told reporters.

nary_nodes.label: Boat departed from Mongala
evidence: He also said that the vessel had departed from Mongala in north-western DR Congo 22 days ago, where there have been no Ebola cases, contrary to earlier reports.

nary_nodes.label: No treatments for Bundibugyo
evidence: There are no drug treatments that specifically target Bundibugyo, nor does it have a vaccine, although the first human trials for one are currently under way in the UK.
